audit_items.proof_trace: All public lending entry points (deposit, withdraw, borrow, repay, flash-loan borrow, liquidate variants, enter_market, claim_reward) call `assert!(!market.has_circuit_break_triggered(), ...)` before any state mutation. The only unchecked functions are `repay_flash_loan` and `repay_flash_loan_increase_referral_qualification`, which are safe by the Move hot-potato constraint: `FlashLoan` has no `drop`/`store` ability and must be consumed in the same transaction it is borrowed in; since `borrow_flash_loan_inner` checks the circuit breaker, no hot potato can exist on a circuit-broken market.
